pages.text: A new body, Collar Cam fitted, in 60 s, for 16 rotten flesh, 8 bone blocks, 4 redstone blocks, 8 slime balls, 2,000 mB of saline and 200 kFE stored first.

$(l)Load it before you need it:$() when you do, you are a jar and your things are on your corpse. Saline goes in by bucket or bottle. From a pile alone, 200 kFE take over 8 min.$(br2)Then, as the jar, press Print. Use the new body, or Swap, to step in.

$(l)Print-to-Order:$() a DNA Fraction of quality 40 or better in the $(l)Template$() slot prints a headless host of its species, in 60 s, at the fraction's quality as freshness. Anyone may press Print; the presser is its employer. The fraction is used up. Printed hosts drop no loot when they die.

The door is one block wide, two tall. $(l)Tiny$() (chicken, rabbit, frog, fish): a quarter of the materials. $(l)Small$() (pig, sheep, wolf, fox, cat): half. $(l)Medium$() (cow, villager, zombie, creeper, strider, llama, squid): a full print. Marine models need water at the doorstep. No bosses, golems, spirits or heads alone.
